name: DEMIURGE_SPIRAL_EVOLUTION
model: A0 -> B0 -> C0 -> ASCEND -> A1 -> B1 -> C1 -> ASCEND -> ...

transient_operations_allowed: bounded active windows when overflow is archived or summarized
scope.note: No-entity-deletion protects learning identity and lineage; it does not require temporary UI/game/runtime objects to remain active forever.

admission.ASCENDED: new active state is measurably or structurally admitted and parent lineage is retained
admission.INTEGRATED_LESSON: candidate is not promoted, but its failure/constraint is retained for the next turn
admission.NO_ASCENT: no new evidence, lesson, constraint or admissible state change
